Messages.Author: Snodig
Messages.Body: Can a vampire A equip something currently attached to vampire B if vampire A doesn’t meet the requirements to play that equipment?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Snodig wrote:
> Can a vampire A equip something currently attached to vampire B if vampire A doesn’t meet the requirements to play that equipment?
>
Yes. As you state it, the requirements are there to "play the card". Equipping from another minion is not playing the card (you don't pay the cost a second time for instance).

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Ratadin
Messages.Body: I would like to remind that, even though you can, for instance, move a Erebu's Mask from a Harbringer of the Skull to, for instance, a Malkavian, this wouldn't benefit from the +1 Stealth as the mask specify "This Harbringer of the Skull...", and the malkavian isn't a Harbringer of the Skull. Meanwhile, you coould move a Revenant from a Tzimisce to the same malkavian, and the malkavian would then gain +1 intercept, as the card specifies "The minion with this retainer", and the malkavian is a minion.
